title: fantasy dungeon (exploration)
about: Master Sword Rebirth's exploration: hubs, branches, dead ends with rewards. The dungeon setting's bands first, the whole kind's where a setting band is missing; the co-op campaign's bands (Vermintide 2's 30 % of floor off the route) for a mixed route with side areas.

width.label: floor width (map's median place)
width.note: the narrowest of eight lines through each walked place; VT2's ends at the navmesh's edge (drops, low walls too)

corridorWidth.label: corridor width (map's p5 place: its narrowest common floor)

passageWidth.label: passage width (gaps between walls, median)
passageWidth.note: GoldSrc: the walk's openings (a wall each side, room either side); VT2: pinches on the main path

openWidth.label: open-space width (map's p95 place: its big rooms and yards)
openWidth.note: no corpus segments rooms; the widest common floor stands in for room size

wideShare.label: wide floor share (4 player heights and over)

headroom.label: headroom, roofed floor (median)
headroom.note: GoldSrc leaves open-sky places out; L4D2: places under 600 units (its sky lid counts as a roof)

corridorHeadroom.label: headroom over narrow floor (median)
corridorHeadroom.note: GoldSrc under 144 units wide, L4D2 under 176

heightRange.label: height range of the walked floor (p5 to p95)

floorLevels.label: floor levels (heights holding 2 % of the floor)
floorLevels.note: on VT2's levels that slope all the way this counts slope, not storeys

sight.label: sightline (map's median place: its longest line)

crossing.label: crossing, walked
crossing.note: GoldSrc: from a way out (an arena: start to farthest floor); L4D2: saferoom to saferoom, finales left out; VT2: the director's main path

crossingRatio.label: walked / straight
crossingRatio.note: VT2's is ill-conditioned where a level comes back near its start; its winding per 100 m is in pathWinding

loops.label: loops (cycles round 512-unit tiles)
loops.note: VT2's tiles scaled by player heights (12.8 m)

alternativeRoutes.label: alternative routes
alternativeRoutes.note: L4D2: stretches of the route with another way round at 39 m; VT2: the director's crossroads. Not the same count

lacks.msr: no route to measure them against; loops stand in
not measured: the walk's graph is not split into rooms and links

offPathShare.label: floor off the route
offPathShare.note: VT2: the director's island zones over all its zoned floor

doorWidth.label: door width
doorWidth.note: GoldSrc: the panel (includes what hides in the frame); L4D2: the prop door's leaf

dropHeight.label: drop height
dropHeight.note: L4D2: nav links falling over 18 units; VT2: the AI's ledges

lacks.msr: drops are walked down, not measured

firstEventAt.label: first event (fraction of the route)
firstEventAt.note: L4D2: the first crescendo; VT2: the first boss route (its scripted events are not placed)

eventsPerKm.label: events per km of route
eventsPerKm.note: L4D2: crescendos; VT2: scripted terror events
